scenes.text: A pattern rule expresses the starting amount and change using a letter such as n.
A rule starts at 23 and increases by 4 per step. Which expression describes it? The answer is 23 plus 4n. Initial value 23, then add 4 for each step n.
A price table during a library project starts at 19 and adds 2 for each new step. Which expression gives the value at step n? Pause the video and think.
A price table during a library project starts at 19 and adds 2 for each new step. Which expression gives the value at step n? The answer is 19 plus 2n. Initial value 19, then add 2 for each step n.
